market_bucketing.boundary: Market variables are reported one at a time. Correlated context variables are not interpreted as independent effects.
market_bucketing.risk_balance: Relative comparison of stored risk_on_score and risk_off_score; not a TSO regime or signal.

repeated_company_control.method: Every cohort reports both observation-weighted and ticker-balanced means; no claim treats all 254 rows as independent companies.
